title: Adding Tools to AI Agents
transcript: Here's the practical advice that saved you all the weeks of debugging. Start with one or two tools. Don't hand your agent 12 tools on day one. More tools means more ways for the model to pick the wrong one, and you won't be able to tell if a failure is a bad tool description, a bad prompt, or a bad model decision. Add tools incrementally, and you'll actually be able to trace broke.
